span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-001: Order Processing
Id: 101
Text: The system shall enable authenticated customers to browse the digital menu, manage shopping cart quantities, and submit food orders.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-002: Server-Side Billing Calculation
Id: 102
Text: The system shall automatically compute order totals and line subtotals based on database menu prices to prevent client tampering.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-003: Real-Time Order Tracking
Id: 103
Text: The system shall broadcast live order preparation status updates to customer devices via WebSocket connections.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-004: Kitchen Ticket Management
Id: 104
Text: The system shall display incoming tickets to kitchen personnel and support status progression (pending -> preparing -> ready -> completed).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-005: Payment Gateway Settlement
Id: 105
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall process digital payments (GCash, Maya, Credit Card) upon order conclusion.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-POS-006: Fiscal Receipt Printing
Id: 106
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall generate official BIR-compliant sales receipts via thermal ESC/POS hardware.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-001: Menu Catalog Management
Id: 201
Text: The system shall maintain dishes categorized by dining course with price, description, and availability flags.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-002: Real-Time Availability Toggling
Id: 202
Text: The system shall allow authorized management staff to instantly toggle menu item availability.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-003: Recipe-Based Stock Depletion
Id: 203
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall deduct raw ingredient inventory quantities upon customer order confirmation.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-004: Supplier Catalog Management
Id: 204
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall record raw material supplier profiles, contracts, and contact directories.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-005: Automated Purchase Requisitions
Id: 205
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall generate purchase orders to suppliers when stock levels reach reorder thresholds.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
«requirement»
REQ-INV-006: Low-Stock Automated Alerts
Id: 206
Text: (PROPOSED) The system shall push alerts to kitchen management when ingredient stock falls below safety limits.
